items.body: The Itinerary follows a pending (unapproved) Auto Reissue change.
An inactive supplier's credential stays saved and selectable.

items: Credential status needs a higher-permission account — The Mohamed Soliman account sees only Edit on credentials (no Deactivate, no Save). At the user's direction, account odeysysadmin made credential 313 Inactive (2026-09-25 17:37–17:39 and 17:41–17:42 UTC; 2026-09-26 11:54–12:30 UTC for the joint re-run of TC-AGENCY-092, with the user watching) and reactivated it; every check was done with the usual account. First recorded Blocked, then re-run

Saved credentials are not restored when a credential is reactivated — Read-time clean-up removed 313 from both saved lists; after reactivation the lists stayed empty (Auto Reissue on with no credential) until restored by hand

Accidental 3-minute deactivation of supplier NDCsbr — At 15:30:04 UTC a probe click on "Deactivate" (no confirmation dialog) set NDCsbr Inactive; restored Active at 15:33:00. Within the user's status grant; recorded in artifacts/incident-NDCsbr-accidental-deactivation.json

Records changed by hand during the run — BRN265/AGN9780 suppliers and selections had changed since 24 Sep; NDCsbr/313 was re-added with the user's approval (15:10) and the preconditions set up before the re-runs
Script defects corrected before reporting — Each was first auto-recorded Failed by a script misreading; both corrections are documented on the case (Results §3.1)
Portal search limits — Portal booking search defaults to one month and allows six months at most; the range was set through the calendar
Environment outage — http://192.168.1.60 stopped responding ~14:45–14:56 UTC; execution paused and resumed; no case affected
Not captured — Console logs and video were not collected; screenshots and request/response records were

REC-1: Decide whether the Itinerary should follow a pending (unapproved) Auto Reissue change — Observed: while AGN9780's change was Pending for approval, Reissue already showed (canAutoReissue true). This may bypass maker–checker
REC-2: Decide whether an inactive supplier's credential should stay selectable/saved for Auto Reissue — Observed: with NDCsbr inactive, 313 stayed saved and offered on both records

REC-3: Stage 3: update TC-AGENCY-092's Expected Result to the user's decision (the Agency picker may offer an inactive credential; the save is refused), and record it as a Project Context decision — User decision 2026-09-26: intended, the API check is enough. The approved case still expects "not offered"
REC-5: Decide whether reactivating a credential should restore it to the selections that clean-up removed — Today they stay empty; spec §4 is silent on reactivation
REC-4: Ask for a confirmation dialog on supplier "Deactivate" — One click deactivates a shared supplier for every organisation (seen during this run)
